cues: Here are the differences the exam asks for.
A progressive wave advances through the medium and carries energy along.
A stationary wave stays put, and transports no energy: energy just sloshes back and forth between neighbouring nodes.
In a progressive wave every particle has the same amplitude.
In a stationary wave the amplitude runs from zero at the nodes to two a at the antinodes.
And all the particles between two nodes move in phase, reversing across each node.
